title: Integrated Plasma snoRNA-Protein Network Analysis Identifies Circulating Molecular Signatures Associated with High-Risk Benign Breast Lesions and Early Breast Cancer.
snippet: High-risk benign breast lesions increase subsequent breast cancer risk, yet circulating molecular patterns that distinguish them from early breast cancer remain poorly defined. title: Splenic Enlargement During Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy for Gastric Cancer: Treatment-Related Phenomenon or Prognostic Biomarker?
snippet: Spleen volume (SV) may increase during systemic chemotherapy, potentially reflecting treatment-related hepatic, hematological, and immune alterations. However, the clinical significance of SV changes during neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NAC) for gastric cancer remains unclear.
